groups.lede: The thorny logo and the name pass. Gjenfødt on all of them, Gjenreist kept as the one alternative.
All-over, torso-sized, every panel printed, then one gold dot.
The Satisfy angle and the grunge shirts.
Structure borrowed from the shirts you sent, art new.

items.name: The signature
items.note: Birch-branch letters, roots dripping toward a gold sun on a ridge. Rays all round the disc here, the upward fan is one edit away.

items.name: Gjenreist, alternative name
items.note: Severe condensed capitals, a rule, a gold disc. The best logo on the board. If the name moves, this is where.

items.name: Doom scale
items.note: The word cut through a torso-sized gold disc, a ridge biting the bottom. One shape, huge.

items.name: Eldsjäl engraving
items.note: Victorian engraving, one figure climbing with a torch that is the sun. The title in a circus-poster serif now, which suits it.

items.name: Ash grave
items.note: Smoke letters over stumps, one birch sapling, the sun on the horizon. The lore in one picture.

items.name: Beacon fires
items.note: Linocut chain of fires from mountain to mountain, each a gold disc. Woodtype wordmark on the chest.

items.name: Torn up by the roots
items.note: Full-back engraving of a fallen spruce, the sun in the crater it left.

items.name: War metal thicket
items.note: The unreadable one. Bone drips, the disc buried in thorns. Reads Nedbrent, would be redrawn as Gjenfødt.

items.name: Stockholm death metal
items.note: Acid-green lightning letters over a stippled dead forest. Reads Återfödd for now.

items.name: Giant sun
items.note: One gold disc with flame rays from collar to hem, tiny black logo at the centre, blank back. Rays are flames here, not the thin fan: decide which.

items.name: Doom longsleeve
items.note: Chrome logo over a disc, Sólhvarf down both sleeves, the fjord on the back. The 1996 longsleeve.

items.name: The whole story
items.note: Burning monitors at the bottom, smoke into birches, snow, the sun. The full-back print for the signature shirt.

items.name: Monument
items.note: Gold foil capitals across the shoulders, a small disc on the chest. The most wearable epic.

items.name: All-over birch
items.note: Trunks edge to edge, sleeves too, a gold disc behind them.

items.name: The hoodie
items.note: Thorn frame, canyon, disc, a small disc on the hood.

items.name: Tour dates
items.note: Classic tour back with Nordic cities. The dates become the rebuilt modules and their launch months.

items.name: Glitch back
items.note: Torn error dialogs, COMMIT FAILED, acid green and magenta. Mørketid on the chest.

items.name: Components of bone
items.note: Bone letters on a spec sheet with dimension lines. Replace the fake measurements with real token values.

items.name: Burning hem
items.note: Grey flames up from the hem, gold embers, a small logo.

items.name: Birch bark letters
items.note: Letters sawn from birch trunks, photoreal. Would print as a photo.

items.name: One dot
items.note: A fingertip of gold on the chest, nothing else.

items.name: Yggdrasil
items.note: A birch rooted in dead monitors and racks, the sun in its crown. The word at the foot now reads Sólhvarf, the record.

items.name: Procession
items.note: Seventies paperback oil: hooded figures carrying the sun up the ridge.

items.name: Fjord dawn
items.note: Romantic painting with the burned city on the shore, rays upward.

items.name: The stair
items.note: Gouache stair over water to the sun, a small figure. Soft.

items.name: Cloud wizard
items.note: Eighties paperback airbrush, a hooded figure on clouds holding the sun. No name on it.

items.name: Art nouveau
items.note: A whooper swan in a vine frame before a gold sun, washed.

items.name: Anatomy of a design system
items.note: Anatomical figure in a mandala of hundreds of tiny UI components.

items.name: Nightdrive
items.note: A Volvo 240 climbing toward the cut sun on a fjord road. Orange, not Miami.

items.name: Synthmin
items.note: Gradient disc with three cuts on the chest, one thin line on the back. The Tuesday shirt.

items.name: Outrun
items.note: Chrome script, teal grid. Stock synthwave, safe.

items.name: Cassette
items.note: Clean flat vector, side A Mørketid. A playlist cover more than a record.

items.name: MothTech
items.note: Ecru, moth holes, tiny ®, a halftone sunrise pasted crooked with a column of small text.

items.name: The sapling
items.note: Scratchy yellow-green word, a photo of a birch sapling through a cracked floor in a circle.

items.name: Running club
items.note: Readable and fun. Spiky sun breaks the disc rule.

items.name: Xerox collage
items.note: Halftone disc, ransom letters, tape, the imprint on the back. Fix the front sun.

items.name: Technical longsleeve
items.note: Reflective ink, a column of dates down the sleeve. Stockholm sunrise times down the arm is the real idea.

items.name: 1994 thrift find
items.note: A worn shirt, thirty years of wash. A photo for the page more than a design.

items.name: White pen, on ice
items.note: A root figure climbing toward the sun, nervous ballpoint strokes. Closest to the Kite shirt.

items.name: Orange reflection
items.note: One ink, stencil word, the reflection breaking into waves. Bold and cheap to print.

items.name: Flaming branch longsleeve
items.note: A birch branch in blue-magenta flames, scrawled lowercase name, flames up the sleeves.

items.name: Glitched team photo
items.note: RGB-split office photo with a scrawled name. Needs the real team photo.

items.name: Militia emblem
items.note: Blackletter, a ring of flames around the ridge and sun, Design System Militia, Til døden.

items.name: Militia, on the body
items.note: The same on a shirt with Product and Tech Militia. Pick one slogan.

items.name: Hands and bones
items.note: Open hands offering the disc on a pedestal of bones, blackletter over them.

items.name: Cycling club
items.note: Two people carrying the sun up a hill, bubbly letters, a paragraph of tiny text. The one white shirt that works.

items.name: 1979 tour
items.note: Chrome bubble letters, rays, a line of figures on the ridge, Sólhvarf Tour MMXXVI. Gloriously uncool.

items.name: The team in flames
items.note: Five in flares with a laptop, blackletter Alt skal skrives om, a forty-year-old wash.

items.name: Pen on white
items.note: Dripping logo, hooded figure raising a sword at the sun, frantic hatching. The pen became a sword this round.

items.name: The server rack
items.note: Chrome logo, four bolts into a lone rack, Alt skal skrives om. The engineers' shirt.

items.name: Red and blue
items.note: Duotone portrait with a lit match, diamond border, Do you know anything about... tokens?

items.name: Mørketid, Europeisk turné
items.note: A rat asleep on a pile of cables, blackletter, 2019 to 2025. The deadpan joke shirt.

items.name: Lynx badge
items.note: A snarling lynx, bold condensed type, one sand ink. The left chest of any shirt here.

items.name: Running on tokens
items.note: Rubber-hose sun running, since MMXXVI. The sweatshirt. Points on the sun allowed here or not, your call.

items.name: Rebuilt from the roots
items.note: A cartoon birch carrying the sun on a tray.

items.name: XIX, the Sun card
items.note: Rider-Waite plate redrawn: the sun with a calm face, a child on a white horse, birches for sunflowers. Gjenfødt in the panel.

items.name: Stave church portal
items.note: Interlaced beasts and vines in Urnes style around the rising disc, the name in carved capitals. Precise and very Norwegian.

items.name: Risograph
items.note: Fluorescent orange and blue, misregistered, the word overprinting the sun. Cheap and bright.

items.name: Sixteen colours
items.note: Chunky pixel sunrise, a small figure on the ridge, Alt skal skrives om. Crisp.

items.name: Contour lines
items.note: A fjord drawn only in contour lines, the water black, the disc where the fjord opens. A scale bar. Could be the quietest shirt here.

items.name: Younger Futhark
items.note: A rune band twisting like a serpent around the disc, transliteration below. The runes need a rune-literate check before print.

items.name: The bootleg
items.note: Rhinestone name, World Tour, gold foil border, random small text, a second logo at the hem. Loud, wrong, perfect.

items.name: The commit log
items.note: Twenty hashes and messages under a rising sun, git log --oneline gjenfødt at the foot. Half the messages are gibberish in the render, typeset the real tracklist.

items.name: Carved in ice
items.note: The name cut into a block of ice on a frozen fjord at sunrise. For the page, or a photo print.

items.name: Geometric
items.note: A gold circle, a black triangle, three bars, the name set vertically. Flat and exact.

items.name: The film poster
items.note: A lone birch in snow, one red sun, the name in a thin serif, en film av Simpløyer. Severe.
